additionalProperties.title: Worker
additionalProperties.description:
A background worker. The table key under `[tool.workers]` is the unique worker ID.

```toml
[tool.workers.<worker-id>]
entrypoint = "<module>:<function>"
```

entrypoint.title: Entrypoint
entrypoint.description:
Python callable to run, in the format:
```
importable.module:some_callable
```

For example, for a worker like:

```python
def run():
    ...
```

in a file at `app/worker.py`, the config could look like:

```toml
[tool.workers.background]
entrypoint = "app.worker:run"
```

This is equivalent to:

```python
from importable.module import some_callable

some_callable()
```

So, `app.worker:run` is equivalent to:

```python
from app.worker import run

run()
```
